entries.title: Civic portrait generation moved to the protected Workers AI allowance
entries.summary: The private Civic Profile portrait generator now uses Cloudflare Workers AI instead of the retired OpenAI image route. Portrait generation and Learning assessment share one auditable daily usage record and the same 9,000-unit protective ceiling. The portal disables the generator before another portrait could cross that ceiling, presents a red daily-limit state with a reset explanation, and refreshes the displayed allowance after successful generation. Portrait uploads remain authenticated, origin-restricted, validated, and private to the generation request.
entries.sourceLabel: The Utopian Society private Civic Profile

changes: Removed the OpenAI-backed Sites portrait route
Added authenticated portrait generation to the civic Worker
Recorded successful portrait generation in the Learning portal's existing daily AI usage row
Refused portrait generation before its estimated use could cross the 9,000-unit protective ceiling
Added a red disabled generator state with a hover and keyboard-focus reset explanation
Refreshed the shared portal allowance immediately after successful generation
Preserved the original 512 x 512 saved-avatar crop while using a model-compatible 496 x 496 generation input
